# Corvane — Ramoira brand schema 3.0.0 example (fictional brand)

Corvane is a fictional cookware maker. This schema illustrates the 3.0.0 format and is not ratified.

- [Full schema](brand.schema.json): rules of every check class, situations, draft provenance
- [Summary](brand.schema.summary.json): the public extract
- [Specification](../../SPEC.md)
